newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sterling House upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sterling House upgraded.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said Friday it upgraded Sterling House Corp to buy from hold with a 12-month price target of $13-$14 a share.

-- McDonald said it is maintaining its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of a loss of $0.05 a share and establishing an estimate of $0.75 for fiscal 1998. The company posted a loss of $0.23 in fiscal 1996, McDonald said.
-- Sterling House's pre-opening costs have continued to trend down recently and the potential exists for a modest positive surprise for fiscal 1997 earnings, McDonald said.
-- Sterling House provides long-term and assisted living care services.
-- Its shares were up 3/8 Friday at 11-1/4.
